piper_free_local_baseline.notes: Official Piper baseline voice for local experiment only. It is not claimed to be South African and is not the final Vesper voice.

piper_sa_english_candidate.accent_claim: South African English only after reviewed voice evidence exists
piper_sa_english_candidate.notes: Reserved for a reviewed South African English Piper model or a locally trained voice with clear licensing and consent provenance.

unsupported_language_policy: LINGUA may render reviewed text, but Vesper must not claim a native spoken voice for a language until an approved voice model and pronunciation review exist.
